shipped.title_o: Nonparametric Estimates of the Components of Productivity and Profitability Change in U.S. Agriculture
shipped.outcome_quote: We consistently find that productivity growth in US agriculture is mainly driven by technical progress.

blind_target.title: Nonparametric Estimates of the Components of Productivity and Profitability Change in U.S. Agriculture.
blind_target.evidence_quote:
In this paper, we replicate O'Donnell
(2012b), who decomposed productivity change in US agriculture (1960–2004) into several economically meaningful measures, and extend the analysis to agriculture in the European Union
(EU) (2000–2019).
blind_target.outcome_computational_quote: We successfully reproduced all results presented in the original paper, including all reported decimal points (two decimals).6
blind_target.outcome_robustness_quote:
Employing various TFP measurement
techniques including nonparametric and parametric approaches, we evaluate the sensitivity of
the results in the original article by O'Donnell (2012b) to alternative choices and methods. The
results show that the original results can be successfully reproduced and that its main results
are very robust.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: Original state-level 1960–2004 data are reanalysed. Authors explicitly recover every reported decimal and judge main results very robust. Alternative indices change magnitudes, but authors retain the central technical-progress conclusion. EU and later global datasets are extensions, not further original papers targeted.

blind_target.title: Reversal of Fortune: Geography and Institutions in the Making of the Modern World Income Distribution.
blind_target.evidence_quote: Results for the original AJR samples, corresponding to the “base sample” columns in tables III and V of AJR, are shown in columns (1) and (4) of Table 1. Each is an exact replication.
blind_target.outcome_computational_quote: Results for the original AJR samples, corresponding to the “base sample” columns in tables III and V of AJR, are shown in columns (1) and (4) of Table 1. Each is an exact replication.
blind_target.outcome_robustness_quote: That is, AJR’s original reversal of fortune for territories, using the urbanization measure, is not robust to dropping the neo-Europes and city states.

shipped.title_o: Genetic Predisposition for Immune System, Hormone, and Metabolic Dysfunction in Myalgic Encephalomyelitis/Chronic Fatigue Syndrome: A Pilot Study
shipped.authors_o: Perez; Jaundoo; Hilton; Del Alamo; Gemayel; Klimas; Craddock; Nathanson
shipped.outcome_quote: The genetic predispositions reported for Chronic Fatigue Syndrome are not supported when reanalyzed with more appropriate control data including those drawn from the same 23andMe pool as the CFS patients.

blind_target.authors: Perez M Jaundoo R Hilton K Del Alamo A Gemayel K Klimas NG et al.
blind_target.title: Genetic predisposition for immune system, hormone, and metabolic dysfunction in myalgic encephalomyelitis/chronic fatigue syndrome: a pilot study.
blind_target.evidence_quote: We reanalyzed the frequency ratio of the highly prevalent snps in CFS from the Perez et al. study to this more appropriate control.
blind_target.outcome_computational_quote: The new ratios were recalculated for the 23andMe control and for the ALFA control and subsequently compared to the original ratios.
blind_target.outcome_robustness_quote: The genetic predispositions reported for Chronic Fatigue Syndrome are not supported when reanalyzed with more appropriate control data including those drawn from the same 23andMe pool as the CFS patients. Out of the original 50 genomic positions presented to have the most prevalent deleterious polymorphisms among CFS sufferers, only three remained that met the original study criterion of at least twice as frequent as healthy individuals.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: Original CFS patient frequencies are retained and re-analyzed against alternative controls. This directly evaluates robustness of the original aggregate data; it does not attempt to regenerate the original numbers using the original control workflow. The original risk findings largely disappear under the alternative control constructions.

shipped.title_o: Predictive modeling of treatment resistant depression using data from STAR*D and an independent clinical study
shipped.outcome_quote: We successfully replicated prior work predicting antidepressant treatment outcomes using machine learning methods and clinical data.

blind_target.authors: Nie Z, Vairavan S, Narayan VA, Ye J, Li QS.
blind_target.title: Predictive modeling of treatment resistant depression using data from STAR*D and an independent clinical study.
blind_target.evidence_quote: We sought to independently replicate the cross-validation findings by Nie et al [15] on the STAR*D dataset, and then externally validate their methodology on another new dataset from the Canadian Biomarker Integration Network in Depression (CAN-BIND)-1 study [26], a multicentre study to discover multi-modal (neuroimaging, electrophysiological, molecular, clinical) biomarkers to predict treatment response in patients with MDD.
blind_target.outcome_computational_quote: The highest balanced accuracy was higher in our study compared to Nie et al (73% versus 71%, respectively). Similarly, our highest AUC was higher at 0.81 versus 0.78, respectively. The z-score of Nie et al’s results in our distributions ranges from -0.4 to -34.
blind_target.outcome_robustness_quote: Regardless, our slightly improved performance is unlikely to be clinically significant, and we instead interpret our results as a successful replication supporting the findings of Nie et al. and our own implementation of data processing and machine learning methods.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: Primary replication reanalyses STAR*D original participants using updated release and reconstructed pipeline; original numerical performance not exactly recovered, with large standardized differences, hence computational issues despite authors calling substantive replication successful. Alternative holdout, feature sets and preprocessing retain predictive performance; authors judge differences clinically unimportant. External CAN-BIND data provide an additional new-sample replication, not evidence on reproduction robustness. Single record_type cannot represent both components, so reproduction prioritizes the direct original-data check. Robustness judgment has uncertainty because some alternate response criteria have reduced performance.
